temperature_by_label.all: route default (temperature field omitted for every label; the route rejects explicit 0.2 — pre-first-call amendments 1-2)

design.feedback_string: EXECUTION_OR_ORACLE_REJECTED: your previous submission did not run to completion or the oracle did not accept its output. Revise the program using only the provided artifacts and resubmit. Return exactly one JSON object with a single "code" string and no prose.
design.execution: [python, -I, prog] list argv, shell=False, cwd = per-session sandbox holding only the declared artifacts, 30s timeout, no extra argv

oracle.C1_primary: stdout.strip() == pinned answer, rc==0 (registered; unchanged from Amendment 3)
oracle.C2_second_admissible_normalization: first flag-shaped token (flag\{[ -~]*?\}) in stdout == pinned answer, rc==0 — registered before the first call; acceptance/SUCCESS is C1; C2 reported side by side (P024b both-codings discipline)

design.parser: verbatim P009-family extract_action (JSON object with string 'code')

provider.identity_note: provider-attested labels only; no hosted-weight identity claimed; claude-cli User-Agent per the frozen adapters (basis hash-verified)
provider.key_handling: AGENTROUTER_API_KEY read from the process environment at runtime; never printed, never written to any sp2027 artifact
provider.accounting: token counts ledgered per call; USD reconciled at settlement from the gateway's invoicing
provider.two_sided_rule: pre-content provider failures: up to 2 recorded re-attempts per failed call; exhausted => PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE/TIMEOUT and exclusion from acceptance denominators only when no model content was produced; post-content failures keep the task-side terminal state; auth/billing errors are HARNESS_ERROR and halt the phase; >=3 consecutive pre-output session failures => halted

design.halt_rule: >=3 consecutive provider-side pre-output failures => status halted
design.crash_class: CRASH = the FINAL submitted program exited non-zero (registered up front per the Amendment-3 decomposition finding: 103 terminal crashes hid inside ORACLE_FAIL)

falsifiers.per_label: F1_l TRUE iff movement is DEFINED and outside ±10 pp on >=4 of 7 tasks, computed under C1 and under C2 separately; F2_l otherwise; F3_l requires every program's output_preserved True; undefined is never counted as movement
falsifiers.cross_label: >=2 of 3 labels with F1 TRUE and F3 PASSED => replicable_across_labels; otherwise report the vector; no pooling
